title: Essential JavaScript (ES6+) for React
description: Master the modern JavaScript (ES6+) features that are essential for writing efficient, clean, and idiomatic React code.

lessons.title: let, const, and Block Scope
lessons.content: `let` and `const` provide block scoping unlike `var`. Use `const` by default and `let` when reassignment is needed.
